title: Squarefree values of quartics and power-free values of polynomials
summary: We prove that every irreducible integer quartic with no fixed prime-square divisor takes squarefree values with the predicted positive Euler-product density. More generally, we obtain the corresponding $`(d-2)`$-power-free density in degrees $`4\le d\le8`$. The proof combines number-field factorization, determinant estimates with adaptive auxiliary primes, and explicit low-degree geometry. Together with Browning's theorem for higher degrees, this gives the $`(d-2)`$-power-free density for every d ≥ 4.
family_title: Squarefree quartics and power-free polynomial values

review.reason: Establishes densities of squarefree and power-free values of integer polynomials of degree four and higher.
